paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 5.74 as of August 18, 2026, with a change of -6.51% compared to the prior close and -6.21% over a window of 22 sessions.
There is one new news item in the last 24 hours, with a headline from Bisnow stating that Fermi has been subpoenaed for records on Project Matador, although no wrongdoing has been alleged.

Recent filings include a Form 4 insider transaction report, a Form 10-Q reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, and an 8-K announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026, with a disclosed annualized base salary and bonus structure.
